test_law.standard: Broad plain conversational foundation, not full 1,001-word completion.

interpretation: Major Level 1 provides complete tested coverage for basic communication.
Reasoning emerges strongly before specialized institutional vocabulary.
Conduct is broadly operational but lacks several explicit norm/obligation terms.
Institutional gaps are concentrated and form a coherent frontier for later levels.
The 250-word set behaves as a first-quarter traversal layer rather than a random vocabulary collection.

decision.constraint: Do not backfill institutional jargon into Level 1 merely to raise the score.
decision.next_design_law: Use the missing frontier plus nearest-empty geometric neighbors to construct Major Level 2 while preserving plain conversational language.

traversal_state.ENGINE_RESPONSE: 81.25% functional coverage; Level 1 passes as broad conversational foundation with expected institutional frontier.
